purpose: Test on real reference trees whether the Lemma-3 budget-preserving projection holds when references are missing, and whether discarding the branch-gate marks - what a practitioner who simply subsets a reference tree does - inflates the inferred minimum source count.

variants.A_full: solve_partial on the full observed leaf set; the reference answer.
variants.B_marks_retained: solve_partial on the retained subset; marks are the backbone saturation violations, retained automatically.
variants.C_naive_subset: solve_mixed on the induced suppressed backbone with marked=(); the naive practitioner. Witnesses are lifted to the original tree and verified there.
variants.D_prescribed_pendant: exact original-edge enumeration oracle with the pendant prescribed at the generating value and an arbitrary missing-reference subset; the W[1]-hard regime.
variants.D1_fixed_one_missing: frozen FPT prescribed-pendant solver, applicable only when exactly one reference is removed.

removal_rules: one = exactly one reference removed; a decimal level removes round(level*N) references and is skipped when fewer than three would remain. random draws without replacement from a registered seed; clade removes the whole-clade leaf set whose size is closest to the target, taking the two closest distinct sets; nearest removes the references with the smallest exact tree distance to any true source point.
caps: cap = K_generating for every variant of a case.
budget_calibration: A solver-free structural census of the bank was run before this protocol, and a 12-case timing pilot was run to size the wall limits. No solver was modified. Per-cell counts are reduced at K>=10 because the pilot showed the structural solver does not complete at cap 10 within a 60 s wall limit; those cells are kept so the censoring is reported rather than hidden.
prediction: Lemma 3 predicts B == A at every level and regime. The four-leaf-star example predicts C > B only when the mark set is non-empty, which on a tree of maximum internal degree three is impossible. The registered census phase measures how often the mark set is non-empty on real trees.
analysis: Retain every job including timeouts and errors; never impute. Count comparisons use only (case, draw) pairs where the compared variants both completed. Report the full distribution of C - A, not only extremes.
limitations: Exactly-explainable families only; noisy families have no exact minimum to compare.
A cap of K_generating means an inflation beyond K is observed as infeasibility within cap, not as a numeric count.
Single run per (case, draw, variant): the measured quantity is an exact integer, not a timing.
No claim about recovery of the generating support.
